description: You are a web developer hired to conduct a network performance audit for a client who runs three major news portals. Microsoft Edge is open. Visit each of the following three websites in Edge and use Edge's built-in Developer Tools to analyze the network requests each page makes when it loads: https://www.bbc.com, https://www.reuters.com, and https://www.theguardian.com. For each site, identify the top 3 largest individual network resources loaded (by transfer size), record the total number of HTTP requests made, and note any performance observations (e.g., slow resources, large images, third-party scripts). Compile your findings into a professional performance audit report and save it to /home/ga/Desktop/network_audit_report.txt. The report must cover all three sites, include specific resource sizes (in KB or MB), and request counts.

metadata.occupation_context: Web Developer - cross-browser network performance testing and documentation
